Jurassic World Dominion.text: The COVID-19 pandemic halted filming for several months and pushed its release back a year.
Jurassic World Dominion.evidence: Because of the COVID-19 pandemic, filming was suspended for several months and the release was delayed by a year.

Star Wars: The Force Awakens.text: The first Star Wars film not to extensively involve creator George Lucas.
Star Wars: The Force Awakens.evidence: The film is the first Star Wars film to not extensively involve franchise creator George Lucas, who only served as a creative consultant in the early stages of production.

Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker.text: Colin Trevorrow was first hired to direct, but left in 2017 and J. J. Abrams returned.
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker.evidence: in August 2015, Colin Trevorrow was hired to direct and to write a script with his collaborator Derek Connolly; ... In September 2017, Trevorrow left the project following creative differences with producer Kathleen Kennedy, and Abrams returned as director.

Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom.text: It was the third Jurassic film to pass the billion-dollar mark at the box office.
Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom.evidence: The film grossed over $1.3 billion worldwide, making it the third Jurassic film to pass the billion-dollar mark,

Deadpool & Wolverine.text: The first R-rated film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
Deadpool & Wolverine.evidence: Deadpool & Wolverine is the first R-rated MCU film, retaining that rating from the prior Deadpool films.

Fast X.text: Justin Lin quit as director the month filming began; Louis Leterrier replaced him a week later.
Fast X.evidence: The film's official title was revealed when principal photography began in April 2022. Lin left as director later that month, citing creative differences, though he retained writing and producing credits. Leterrier was then hired as his replacement a week later

Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Ti.text: It was shot with 3D cameras over 106 days, and ten companies worked on its visual effects.
Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Ti.evidence: Principal photography lasted for 106 days between June and November 2010, with locations in Hawaii, the United Kingdom, Puerto Rico and California. Filming employed 3D cameras, and ten companies were involved with the film's visual effects.

Avengers: Age of Ultron.text: Footage was shot as far afield as South Africa, South Korea and Bangladesh.
Avengers: Age of Ultron.evidence: Second unit filming began in February 2014 in South Africa, ... Additional footage was filmed in Italy, South Korea, Bangladesh, the state of New York, and around England.

Avengers: Endgame.text: It was first announced in 2014 as Part 2 of Avengers: Infinity War.
Avengers: Endgame.evidence: The film was announced in October 2014 as Avengers: Infinity War – Part 2, but Marvel Studios later removed this title.

Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny.text: Plans for a fifth film date back to a 1979 deal with Paramount to make five Indiana Jones films.
Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny.evidence: Plans for a fifth Indiana Jones film date back to 1979, when a deal was made with Paramount Pictures to produce five Indiana Jones films.
